newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FAI reiterates it sees profit improvement.
newsitem.headline: FAI reiterates it sees profit improvement.

text.p: FAI Insurances Ltd expects profits to continue to grow in the future, FAI Director and Chief Financial Officer Timothy Mainprize said at a roadshow in Singapore on Wednesday.
"Our profits will continue to improve over the next few years," Mainprize told potential investors in the insurance company's recently announced US$75 million floating rate note.
In February, Chief Executive Rodney Adler said in a statement the company should maintain profit growth in the absence of abnormal events in the insurance field.
The company's net profit for the first half ended December 31 rose by 35.4 percent to Australian $7.7 million.
Mainprize noted the company's claims paying ability was upgraded by Standard and Poor's Corp last October to an investment-grade BBB-minus.
"We are reasonably confident that we shall be upgraded up again," he said.
He said FAI was talking with a large U.S. insurer -- which he did not identify -- about the possibility of entering into an agreement to market Information Technology insurance.
